return_rules: one PNG per slot id, named exactly as 'file' says, sizes per spec §2
pure white #FFFFFF background; no text, letters, numerals or glyphs inside any image
each file shows only what its own slot says — never a crop from a larger sheet, never a neighbouring slot's picture
fill 'delivered' with the filename, or leave it null with a 'note' saying why — never substitute
deliver assets/art/ + this file only; no index.html, no 404.html, no teacher.html

reconciliation_note: The plan predates SC-097 in two rows: every 'Sara' below is خَدِيجَة, and the figure in obj-photo wears two plaits, not a hijab. Applied here.

slots.event: كَرِيم has a big bag; in it a book, a pen and the house key
slots.show: كَرِيم (neutral), the big bag open, book, pen and key visible inside it
slots.risks: three objects in the bag must read as three distinct icons; nothing else in frame

slots.event: On the way home he sees a key on the ground
slots.show: كَرِيم (questioning) walking, the bag closed on his shoulder; a key on the floor line ahead of him; a house with a door far right
slots.must_not_show: the bag's contents
slots.risks: the key on the ground must be the same drawing as frame 1's key — deliberately

slots.event: He puts the key in his bag and decides to ask زَيْد
slots.show: كَرِيم's hand placing the key into the (closed-flap) bag; a small "?" is not drawn — the question is in the text
slots.must_not_show: the bag's interior
slots.risks: keep the bag flap up so the interior stays unseen

slots.event: زَيْد, at his door: no, my key is in my bag
slots.show: كَرِيم holding up the key at زَيْد's door; زَيْد (flat cap) in the doorway with his small bag on his shoulder, patting it
slots.risks: two bags in frame: كَرِيم's big, زَيْد's small; the key is in كَرِيم's hand, not زَيْد's

slots.event: مَهَا: my key is under the book
slots.show: كَرِيم at مَهَا's door with the key up; مَهَا (hair tie) in the doorway; beside her, on the floor line, a book with a key's bow peeping from under it
slots.risks: مَهَا and the book must not overlap; the peeping key must be small but the same drawing; sensitivity: two children at a doorway, no touch, ordinary distance

slots.event: عُمَر: my key is on the door — and you?
slots.show: كَرِيم at عُمَر's door; عُمَر (spikes, happy) pointing at a key hanging on the door; كَرِيم pointing at his own bag
slots.risks: three keys exist in the story by now (found, عُمَر's, كَرِيم's-in-bag): only two in frame — كَرِيم's hand and the door

slots.event: كَرِيم comes home; a cat at the door
slots.show: كَرِيم walking toward his own house (same house as frame 2); the cat sitting upright at the door, neutral, looking at nothing
slots.must_not_show: any hint that the cat knows: no cat looking at the key, no cat looking at the bag, no cat mouth open
slots.risks: the cat's marker must be legible at strip size (ears + tail)

slots.event: The reveal: the bag holds book and pen but no key; the key in his hand is his own; he laughs; both go in
slots.show: كَرِيم (laughing) with the bag open showing book and pen only, the key in his other hand; the cat (`-talk`) beside him; the door ajar
slots.risks: the open bag must clearly show *two* objects where frame 1 showed three — that gap is the whole reveal; nothing else in frame

slots.event: رَزَان has a picture of herself and خَدِيجَة; puts it in her bag; sets off
slots.show: رَزَان (happy) holding `obj-photo` (its two tiny figures: bundles + two plaits), her bag open beside her
slots.must_not_show: خَدِيجَة herself
slots.risks: the photo's tiny figures must read as the two girls at strip size — bundles and two plaits only, no faces

slots.event: At خَدِيجَة's house — calls — خَدِيجَة isn't there
slots.show: رَزَان (talking) at a house with the door closed; nothing else
slots.must_not_show: خَدِيجَة anywhere; the photo
slots.risks: a closed door must read as "nobody" — no window, no second figure

slots.event: رَنَا: خَدِيجَة went to your house
slots.show: رَنَا (bob, talking) pointing back along the floor line the way رَزَان came; رَزَان (questioning)
slots.must_not_show: خَدِيجَة
slots.risks: رَنَا's pointing arm must point away from خَدِيجَة's house, toward رَزَان's

slots.event: Back home — not here either — رَزَان is sad
slots.show: رَزَان (sad variant) at her own house, door closed; her bag on her shoulder
slots.must_not_show: خَدِيجَة
slots.risks: the sad mouth line is the only expression change in the strip; nothing else "sad" (no rain, no tear)

slots.event: Back at خَدِيجَة's house — خَدِيجَة is there — رَزَان gives her the picture
slots.show: خَدِيجَة (happy) at her open door; رَزَان (happy) holding out `obj-photo`
slots.must_not_show: خَدِيجَة's own picture — خَدِيجَة's hands are empty or one hand on the doorframe
slots.risks: two identical-marker-bearing girls plus a photo of them: keep the photo small and held out between them

slots.event: خَدِيجَة gives her one too — the same picture — both laugh
slots.show: Both girls (happy), each holding a `obj-photo` identical to the other's, held up side by side
slots.risks: the two photos must be the same drawing, same size — the joke is identity; no hearts, no hug (SC-027): they stand apart, each holding a picture
